name: re-sandbox
description: Containerized reverse-engineering toolkit (50 MCP tools) for PE/ELF/Mach-O, Motorola DSP56300 firmware/ROMs, binary/hex conversion, C++ RTTI/VTables, .NET, Android APK/DEX, Python, Go, WASM, and Electron binaries.
suggestedPrompts: Run initial triage, compiler/packer detection, and header entropy analysis on the binary in samples/
Disassemble the Motorola DSP56300 ROM in samples/ using dsp56300_disassemble and save the assembly to output/
Decompile the main entrypoint and recover C++ RTTI/VTables into output/
